priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect at all times and use Mirror Image before combat starts.
Use Counterspell to interrupt enemy casts as needed.
Use Evocation when mana is below 10% and major cooldowns like Arcane Surge or Touch of the Magi are not active.
Cast Arcane Surge as your primary damage cooldown to initiate the burn phase.
Cast Touch of the Magi (off-GCD) immediately after Arcane Surge or when available if Surge is on a long cooldown.
Use combat potions, racial power-ups (like Berserking or Blood Fury), and offensive trinkets during Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi windows.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges while the Arcane Soul buff is active.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges if Touch of the Magi is about to expire (less than one GCD remaining).
Cast Arcane Barrage if Arcane Salvo reaches 25 stacks to maximize Sunfury benefits.
Cast Arcane Missiles whenever Clearcasting is active, prioritizing its use during Touch of the Magi and Arcane Surge.
Cast Arcane Orb if you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges to rapidly build resources.
Cast Arcane Blast as your primary filler to generate Arcane Charges and deal single-target damage.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges as a fallback to clear charges and reset if you are not currently in a cooldown window or pooling resources.
